answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable jade bond before it can earn: the bond is slashed if peers prove fake work, so one operator running many clones pays per clone. Reputation then flows like a river — it accumulates only from completed, peer-attested jobs and cannot be transferred or bought. A quartz-clear audit trail links every payout to the bonded identity, so a Sybil farm must fund and age every fake separately, making large-scale fakery costlier than honest work.
